irregularities.title: 124 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: Roster index pruned 25 record(s) no current source supports
irregularities.detail: The player index is pruned each run: a (club, player) record is dropped when the official report names the player under a different club and no current source still asserts it, or when no source has asserted it for 14 days. Dropped this run: PHI:elijah-moore (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); BUF:brock-bowers (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:spencer-burford (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:foley-fatukasi (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:tonka-hemingway (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:ashton-jeanty (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:patrick-johnson (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:jalen-nailor (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:segun-olubi (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:carter-runyon (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:dont-e-thornton (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:dareke-young (official report lists the player under a different club); BUF:trey-zuhn (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:alijah-clark (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:cobie-durant (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:tyler-guyton (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:james-houston (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:ceedee-lamb (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:von-miller (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:demarvion-overshown (official report lists the player under a different club) (+5 more). This is the guard against stale records mis-attributing in-game events (see the 2026-09-16 HOU/GB misattribution in the README verification log).

irregularities.title: 21 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. irregularities.title: Beat writer Daniel Oyefusi is attributed across 2 clubs (NYJ, CLE)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Daniel Oyefusi (ESPN.com) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
